method.stop_marker: successful worker_report_history.py archive with terminal state RUN_FINISHED|COMPLETE|WAITING|BLOCKED|DONE mapped back to exact MCP caller
method.invalid_stop_example: Owl state=COMPLETED archive rejected at 2026-09-07T21:00:36.855+03:00; same caller state=DONE archive ok:true at 2026-09-07T21:00:50.956+03:00

run_age_result.interpretation: Prior old/tool-heavy-state correlation from the generic gap cohort does not survive worker-stop filtering; it was substantially contaminated by ordinary post-stop/user-wait gaps.

connection_semantics.interpretation: connection_id is transport plumbing and may be shared across unrelated callers; connection replacement is not evidence of backend-worker replacement.

confirmed_reroute_constraints: Visible reroute can begin while MCP work is still active.
Visible reroute can occur during a 10-second no-change read_output wait with a ~365-byte response, so large output is not necessary for banner onset.

Owl visible safety-buffering banner later overlapped a 113.366-second zero-MCP/zero-live-child tool-plane-silent interval, then fresh MCP activity appeared under the same observed connector fingerprint after stop/go; exact v0.153.1 code means this does not establish backend inactivity.
Large completed tool results strongly predict intra-run silent gaps, but they are not sufficient or necessary to identify a visible reroute.

classification_rule.confirmed_tool_plane_silence: no successful matching stop archive + zero new MCP calls + zero live connector child processes for the affected caller over the interval
classification_rule.ui_overlap_label: independent screenshot/banner evidence may establish that visible safety buffering overlapped the tool-plane-silent interval
classification_rule.backend_stall_not_inferable_from_mcp_alo: zero MCP plus zero connector child is compatible with the client awaiting remote Responses stream events while the turn remains inProgress
classification_rule.backend_stall_requires: additional Responses/inference-channel evidence such as an idle-timeout/error or server-side timing evidence
classification_rule.historical_candidate_only: gap inside a mapped still-open worker run that resumes before successful archive; without independent UI evidence do not call it a safety-buffering interval

clean_labeled_positive_2026_09_06_2144.interpretation: Confirmed visible reroute occurred mid-run during normal active polling; same caller continued substantial work and later emitted a valid RUN_FINISHED archive. Banner onset is not equivalent to MCP stall or worker stop.

product_artifact_distinction.banner_gate: safetyBuffering.showBufferingUi == true on an in-progress turn

safety_handler.behavior: ResponseEvent::SafetyBuffering only forwards EventMsg::SafetyBuffering; no pause, cancellation, or tool-blocking action occurs in this branch.

remote_wait_path.behavior: try_run_sampling_request opens the remote Responses stream and awaits stream.next() under the turn cancellation token.

safety_parser_test.result: SafetyBuffering events interleave with ordinary OutputTextDelta events and Completed; response events are not dropped.

stream_idle_timeout.sse_behavior: timeout(idle_timeout, stream.next()) -> idle timeout waiting for SSE only after expiration
stream_idle_timeout.websocket_behavior: timeout(idle_timeout, ws_stream.next()) -> idle timeout waiting for websocket only after expiration

exact_release_execution_path_correction.classification_correction: The 113.366-second Owl interval is confirmed tool-plane silence with backend/model state unknown, not a confirmed machine-side/backend stall.
exact_release_execution_path_correction.x_codex_turn_state_correction: x-codex-turn-state is sticky routing/continuation state; it is not evidence of pause semantics.

connector_identity_semantics.caller_id: pseudonymous connector identity derived from request header material; not named/backend worker identity
connector_identity_semantics.session_id: fingerprint of MCP/OpenAI session header material; not app-turn/model-worker identity
connector_identity_semantics.correction: Replace same logical worker/caller-session continuity claims with same observed connector fingerprint unless stronger evidence is present. For Owl, preserved edge telemetry now supplies exact upstream distributed trace-id continuity across Stop -> go; that proves tracing lineage, not backend model-worker/app-turn identity.

stop_go_continuity.interpretation: Exact upstream distributed tracing lineage spans the manual Stop -> go boundary; this is stronger than connector fingerprint continuity but does not identify a model worker, inference request, or exact app turn.

overlap.interpretation: Distinct upstream trace contexts interleaved MCP work and launched separate external processes under one connector session; separate model workers are not proven.
